item.title: More control over medical-record updates
item.summary: Request daily checks when connecting a supported patient portal, and see when Murph last checked and plans to check again.
item.details: Import results are easier to scan, with extra counts under Import details. Ongoing access depends on your portal and the access period you approve. Unsupported connections remain one-time imports. Disconnect stops future imports while keeping saved records; account deletion and health-data consent controls are linked from Medical records.
